name: You Have Served Us Well
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I hear Lord Wishock enjoyed his beverage.

You have served us well, adventurer.  The Warlocks of Stormwind will be able to practice our ways without disturbance, thanks to you.  For your efforts, I have prepared a special gift for you.  Speak with my servant, Zggi, and claim your reward.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.
narrative.offerRewardText: Master says give gift to adventurer. Zggi wants to keep nice gift but Zggi knows better than to betray Master.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 30, 5,150 XP in all.

quests.name: A Noble Brew
quests.objectiveText: Zardeth the Black Claw wants you to bring him a Tear of Tilloa from Darkshire and a Musquash Root from the Wetlands.

quests.name: A Noble Brew
